text:
Type: faux fur throw pillow
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, modern
Materials: soft plush faux fur
Colors: charcoal grey, cool grey
Shape: square, shaggy fluffy pile, soft rounded edges, large and plump
Feel: cozy, soft, warm, luxurious
Goes with: velvet sofas, white or grey bedding, silver or brass accents; glam or modern bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Glam Soft Faux Fur Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Grey
product.description: Add a touch of luxurious texture to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes a bit of glam along with warmth and coziness. The modern grey color will enhance your transitional or modern-style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat.
